description: Stress Relief Music | Sitar Instrumental | 1.5 Hours of warm Indian classical sitar to let the day's tension go.
When your mind won't stop replaying the day — let the sitar slow it down. Ninety minutes of deep, warm sitar in Raga Yaman, the great evening raga, to unwind the body and quiet the noise.

⏱ BEST FOR — stress relief · unwinding after work · a racing mind · evening calm
🎵 ABOUT — Raga Yaman is Indian classical music's evening raga, played for centuries to settle the mind at dusk.
